due_when.clears_when: summarize() computes real drawdown/Sharpe/total_pnl_pct from the trade list (src.backtest.backtester.ICTBacktester already has correct logic for this and can be reused), or explicitly stamps them null/unmeasured instead of 0.0, with a test covering src.backtest.run_backtest for the first time.

what: AUD-20260927-CA-A15-run-backtest-summarize-fabricated-zeros: src/backtest/run_backtest.py::summarize() hardcodes max_drawdown, max_drawdown_pct, sharpe_ratio and total_pnl_pct to 0.0 regardless of the actual trade list (lines ~116-120), even on the branch that has real trades -- these are not computed at all, not merely defaulted. run_backtest() is invoked by scripts/ops/run_serious_baseline.sh against a real DB, and that DB is then built into the ml/datasets/families/backtest_results.py ML dataset family via `python -m ml build-dataset backtest_results`, so fabricated 0.0 values (not distinguishable from a genuinely-zero drawdown/Sharpe) flow into ML training data. No test imports src.backtest.run_backtest at all.
